data.narrative:
DEFCON AI is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Yisroel Brumer, Paul Selva, and Grant Verstandig that has raised $44M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers spanning both public equities (2 names: DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and private companies (8 names including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $44M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implying a $110M valuation. Peer-median analysis references three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—UFORCE at $1.0B (Seed), Singularity at $400M (Series A), and NODA AI at $125M (Series A)—yielding a $400M median with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B. The median across the two methods is $255M.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $94M (low) to $460M (high), with a midpoint of $255M. The 4.9x spread between low and high reflects material uncertainty around stage-specific step-up timing and relative positioning within a differentiated peer set. Key sensitivities include timing to Series A close, customer traction relative to peer benchmarks, and macroeconomic effects on defense-sector funding velocity.
